title: Astrocyte Isolation and Transfection for Astrocytes/Neuron Co-Culture Assay
author: Justin T Savage
materials: Prepare the following solutions (enough for 9 pups) Tube Label DPBS # of Aliquots + Additive Notes Lo OVO 36ml 2 2ml aliquot Add 400µl DNase before use Hi OVO 20ml 2 2ml aliquot BSA Buffer 76ml 2 2ml aliquot Divide among 2 50ml Falcon Tubes Panning (X2 tubes) 45ml 500µl insulin + 5ml BSA buffer Insulin, do not use if >6 weeks’ old
Aspirate off the supernatant with a vacuum.
Warm-up AGM and DPBS in a water bath
Aspirate the DPBS and dislodged cells
Warm up an aliquot of AGM in incubator.

Prepare the following solutions (enough for 9 pups) Tube Label DPBS # of Aliquots + Additive Notes Lo OVO 36ml 2 2ml aliquot Add 400µl DNase before use Hi OVO 20ml 2 2ml aliquot BSA Buffer 76ml 2 2ml aliquot Divide among 2 50ml Falcon Tubes Panning (X2 tubes) 45ml 500µl insulin + 5ml BSA buffer Insulin, do not use if >6 weeks’ old

steps.title: Prepare dissection surface
steps.instruction: Clean the benchtop with ethanol, place an absorbent pad, and arrange tools: small curved spring scissors, larger scissors for decapitation, and forceps.

steps.title: Set up DPBS dishes
steps.instruction: Label three 60 mm dishes and add 5 ml DPBS to each for collecting six cortices per dish; label one 10 cm dish and add 12 ml DPBS for the dissection.

steps.title: Decapitate and de‑skin pups
steps.instruction: Decapitate pups, remove the skin from the heads, and trim the skull around but above the ears up to the midline with small scissors so the skull peels off.

steps.title: Extract brains
steps.instruction: Remove the brains and place them into the 10 cm dish containing DPBS.

steps.title: Isolate cortex tissue
steps.instruction: Using forceps, strip away meninges and dissect away basal ganglia, hippocampus, and cerebellum, leaving isolated cortical tissue.

steps.title: Transfer cortices to fresh dish
steps.instruction: Move the isolated cortices to a fresh 60 mm dish containing DPBS.

steps.title: Chop cortices
steps.instruction: Cut the cortices with scissors to increase surface area for enzymatic digestion.

steps.title: Prepare papain solution
steps.instruction: Resuspend papain according to the kit instructions and add DNase (amount not specified) to the solution.

steps.title: Modify pipette tip
steps.instruction: Cut off the tip of a sterile plastic disposable pipette to create a larger opening.

steps.title: Transfer tissue to papain
steps.instruction: Using the modified pipette, suction the chopped tissue and DPBS, tap the tip onto the papain solution in a 20 ml universal tube without squeezing, then swirl gently to create a “tornado effect” before allowing the tissue to settle.

steps.title: Papain digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 33 °C for 45 min, swirling the tissue gently every 15 min.

steps.title: Add DNase before end of digestion
steps.instruction: Just before the end of the papain incubation, add 400 µl DNase to the Lo‑Ovo solution.

steps.title: Remove DPBS after digestion
steps.instruction: After the 45‑min incubation, aspirate the DPBS from the universal tube; the tissue will remain at the bottom.

steps.title: First trituration with Lo‑Ovo
steps.instruction: Add 2 ml Lo‑Ovo gently down the side of the tube, triturate with a 1 ml pipette about 10 up‑and‑down passes, check for a single‑cell suspension, add up to 1 ml more Lo‑Ovo if needed, then add the remaining Lo‑Ovo to the dissociated cells.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells at 1100 rpm for 11 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant with a vacuum without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend in Hi‑Ovo
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 2 ml Hi‑Ovo, triturate with a 1 ml pipette about 10 passes, then add the remaining Hi‑Ovo.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 1100 rpm for 11 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Astrocyte Growth Media
steps.instruction: Combine for 500 ml filtered AGM: DMEM 450 ml, FBS 50 ml, Pen‑Strep (100×) 5 ml, Glutamate (100×) 5 ml, Sodium Pyruvate (100×) 5 ml, Insulin 5 ml, N‑Acetyl Cysteine 500 µl, Hydrocortisone 500 µl. Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dilute PDL stock
steps.instruction: Dilute 100 µl poly‑D‑lysine (PDL) in 10 ml sterile water.

steps.title: Coat 75 cm² flasks with PDL
steps.instruction: Add enough 10 µg/ml PDL solution to cover each 75 cm² flask, incubate ≥30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash and add AGM to flasks
steps.instruction: Wash each flask three times with sterile ddH₂O, add 15 ml AGM, and place flasks in the incubator with the lid slightly twisted off to equilibrate CO₂ and temperature.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in 2–3 ml warmed AGM, bring the volume to 10 ml, then filter the suspension through a 20 µm Nitex membrane 1 ml at a time into a 50 ml Falcon tube (ethanol/flame‑sterilize forceps before use).

steps.title: Centrifuge filtered cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered cells at 1100 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend for counting
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 2 ml AGM, bring the volume to 10 ml, and count the cells.

steps.title: Plate astrocytes at high density
steps.instruction: Plate a minimum of 15 × 10⁶ cells (preferably 17–20 × 10⁶) per 75 cm² flask; add the calculated volume to the pre‑coated flasks and store with the cap slightly unscrewed.

steps.title: Check astrocyte morphology
steps.instruction: Inspect the cultures under a microscope for normal astrocyte morphology.

steps.title: Wash with DPBS
steps.instruction: Wash the cells with 10 ml DPBS at least three times.

steps.title: Shake to detach other cells (first)
steps.instruction: Add 15 ml DPBS and shake the flasks at least 10 times to detach non‑astrocyte cells.

steps.title: Shake to detach other cells (second)
steps.instruction: Add another 15 ml DPBS, examine under a microscope for debris and ‘holes’; if insufficient, shake more vigorously.

steps.title: Add fresh AGM
steps.instruction: Add 15 ml AGM to the flasks and return to the incubator.

steps.title: Add AraC to AGM
steps.instruction: Warm AGM in a water bath and add AraC to achieve a 1:10 000 dilution.

steps.title: Replace AGM with AraC‑containing media
steps.instruction: Remove the old AGM and replace with 15 ml fresh AGM containing AraC per flask; store in the incubator.

steps.title: Scale note
steps.instruction: The above steps describe preparation for one flask; scale volumes proportionally for additional flasks.

steps.title: Warm reagents for passaging
steps.instruction: Warm trypsin, AGM, and DPBS in a water bath.

steps.title: Coat 12‑well plate with PDL
steps.instruction: Dilute 100 µl PDL in 10 ml water, add 0.5 ml of 10 µg/ml PDL to each well of a 12‑well plate, incubate ≥30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash and add AGM to 12‑well plate
steps.instruction: Wash each well three times with sterile ddH₂O, add 1 ml AGM, and let sit in the incubator while astrocytes are being passaged.

steps.title: Rinse astrocyte flask with PBS
steps.instruction: Remove old AGM from the flask, then rinse the flask three times with PBS lacking Mg²⁺ and Ca²⁺.

steps.title: Trypsinize astrocytes
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml pre‑warmed trypsin to the flask, incubate 5 min at 37 °C in a flat (non‑stacked) position.

steps.title: Collect detached astrocytes
steps.instruction: Tap the flask to loosen cells, then collect all dislodged astrocytes with a 10 ml pipette.

steps.title: Centrifuge collected astrocytes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1.1 × 10³ rpm for 10 min to pellet the astrocytes.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in AGM
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 2 ml AGM, pipette up and swirl to dislodge, then dispense and swirl gently until a uniform cell suspension is achieved.

steps.title: Plate astrocytes in 12‑well plate
steps.instruction: Plate 0.2 × 10⁶ astrocytes per well of the prepared 12‑well plate and store in the incubator.

steps.title: Prepare DNA‑Plus‑OptiMEM mix
steps.instruction: For each well, combine 1 µl of 1 µg/µl DNA, 1 µl Plus reagent, and 64 µl Opti‑MEM; mix and let stand 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare LTX mixture
steps.instruction: In a separate tube, mix 2 µl LTX with 64 µl Opti‑MEM (condition‑tested); add 66 µl of this LTX mixture to each DNA‑Plus tube and incubate 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Refresh AGM before transfection
steps.instruction: Remove and save 0.5 ml old AGM, then add 0.5 ml fresh AGM to the astrocytes and another 0.5 ml fresh AGM to the saved media.

steps.title: Add DNA/LTX to wells
steps.instruction: Add 132 µl of the DNA/LTX mixture to each well in a swirling motion.

steps.title: Incubate transfection
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 2.5 h; meanwhile warm an aliquot of DPBS.

steps.title: Wash post‑transfection
steps.instruction: Wash each well three times with 1 ml DPBS.

steps.title: Add saved AGM mixture
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of the saved/fresh AGM mixture to each well.

steps.title: Warm reagents for second passaging
steps.instruction: Warm trypsin, DPBS, and a 10 ml aliquot of AGM in a water bath.

steps.title: Loosen astrocytes for collection
steps.instruction: After incubation, tap the plate gently to loosen astrocytes and transfer the cells into a prepared 15 ml tube.

steps.title: Add AGM to collection tube
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml AGM to the fresh 15 ml tube for each condition.

steps.title: Second trypsinization
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 ml trypsin per well (12‑well plate), incubate 6 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash after second trypsinization
steps.instruction: Aspirate old AGM and wash three times with DPBS.

steps.title: Centrifuge after second trypsinization
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1.1 × 10³ rpm for 10 min to pellet astrocytes.

steps.title: Resuspend in neuronal medium
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant and resuspend the pellet in neuronal medium.

steps.title: Plate astrocytes onto neurons
steps.instruction: Count and plate 20 000 astrocytes into each well of the neuronal culture (see separate neuron isolation protocol).
